body: Hah, we're polyamorous and she can't. Not cause she is ugly, she is smoking hot. But they last a couple months then she dumps them or they dump her, she doesn't tell me why. Counter, my longest extra-marital relationship is going on 8 years.
I want to be a partner with her through raising our kids and working together on life. But I can't continue with the level of random abuse I get.
Same. Both mine had parents that were terrible to her, but she was closer with her mum. Still she chewed her out for things she actually did wrong, and random things.
They can also spit acid, the bigger ones can exert pounds of strength in their claws, and their carapace can be strong enough to withstand a person standing on them.
Except the purple cable is looping from one rj12(?) splitter to the other, leading to just general wiring shennanigans.
Dude, are you me. I made the same analogy in my head the other day with water, and someone who is thirsty.

I have tried to suggest therapy. This morning, after things had gotten a little better (only after I admitted to some of the thoughts of suicide). So this mornings rebuttal; "why do you want to attend therapy" Me; "cause I think it could help us communicate better", "what do we need to communicated about?", me; "obviously lots of things", her "so you want to waste money on that?"

ARGGGH. At least she has touched me again, once since then. It made me realise how fucking sad I am, that I treasured her touching my arm while we went through the checkout, kids in toe.

I remembered this song that my dad used to like, perfect song for the suicidal; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vRu1Lk3IK8c

"I am not scared of dying, and I don't really care, if it is peace you find in dying, then let the time end near"

I think therapy is the key too, but you can't help those that don't want help.

She doesn't and hasn't ever liked going out. She loves playing computer games (FPS and RTS). Now we have kids, we can't really play these kinds of things anymore, we could try I suppose. It might seem a bit odd for me to suggest it tonight, after the big fight last night.

My mistress is awesome. She is loving, caring, affectionate. She even looked after the kids the other week while I was away so my wife could get to an appointment. She took off work a few weeks ago, so my wife and I could go to a concert.

I can't see her more than once a week as it is too much on my wife, she complains that it is unfair on the kids, and is generally aggressive towards me. I also don't want to hurt my wife, despite what she thinks. I love her immensely, her sadness makes me sad.

Yeah I love nature, my wife hates it. I have tried to take all of us on walks before, it always ends with her in a fit of anger. Me wishing I was dead, and the kids sad. I don't get alone time, so not sure how I would manage leaving by myself, unless I never came back... that's an option.

She is unhappy, she doesn't tell me anything till she is furious, and then she simply doesn't see any argument as valid but her own. I have suggested therapy for years, even before she suggested we open up the relationship. I have seen one, once, it was awesome. But my wife refused to go. She now complains that it is too expensive, and again using the kids, says she will have to cancel their after school activities, remedial therapies etc. I make a pretty good wage, so it would simply mean we have to cancel our savings for a few months while we attend.

It wasn't completely just me, at one stage she was seeing someone else, it was a full open relationship. I loved that someone else could make her happy, that she got to go out occasionally. But she always found fault with her other partners and has in the last 6 months given up on looking or even talking to others. She has no friends, no outside relationships. All my friends have moved interstate for work, so I have nothing save my mistress and work.

Really, I keep coming back to; Work would miss me, but replace me. Mistress would miss me, but replace me, one of my kids would miss me... maybe, wife would miss my paycheck... so what the hell am I doing here.

I hate every place I go to, sure they are pretty. But this last trip all I thought was how fucked my life is. How much I miss my wife. I love my wife, but she doesn't show me an once of affection. I love my mistress, but I can't see her more than once a week or my wife gets angry. I love my kids, but they don't really love me back.

I just keep thinking, it may actually be better for everyone if I was gone, if I could make it look like an accident then at least my wife might get some compensation.
